title: Interiorem Solutions Brand System
briefDescription: Complete brand identity transformation for construction interior solutions company, from discovery through to full asset development.
description: Interiorem Solutions required a comprehensive brand identity that would position them as the premium choice in construction interior solutions. This project encompassed strategic brand development including four distinct creative routes, extensive stakeholder collaboration, and full asset creation from stationery to merchandise.
challenge: Interiorem Solutions needed to establish a distinctive brand identity in the competitive construction interiors market. The challenge was creating a visual system that communicated both technical expertise and premium positioning, while remaining versatile across digital and physical touchpoints.
solution: We developed a comprehensive brand strategy beginning with in-depth discovery and competitor analysis. Four distinct creative routes were presented, each exploring different aspects of the brand personality—from architectural precision to approachable professionalism. Through iterative refinement based on client feedback, we arrived at a final direction that balanced sophistication with industry credibility. The complete asset suite included logo variations, colour palette, typography system, brand patterns, stationery (business cards, letterheads, envelopes, email signatures), and branded merchandise (polo shirts, fleeces).
results: Full stationery suite designed and print-ready
Brand patterns for digital and print applications
brandMessage: Strategic brand development that transforms construction businesses from commodity providers to premium partners.
whatWeLearned: The construction industry responds well to brands that balance professionalism with approachability. Multiple creative routes allowed the client to see genuine alternatives rather than variations on a single theme, leading to more confident final decisions.
